analyst_view.overall: Early view: a game between two sides near the bottom, both on 3 points. RB Leipzig (30th) lost 3-2 at home to Manchester City on matchday 4 but scored twice, while Lens (33rd) were thrashed 9-1 at home by Como. I found little fresh team news for either club, so this view rests on the matchday 4 results and the table.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals and I lean higher. Lens conceded nine at home to Como, which suggests a defence in real trouble, and Leipzig scored twice against City through Ridle Baku and Antonio Nusa. Both teams need to win to stay in the hunt for the play-off places.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.3 corners and I stay with it. Leipzig should have most of the ball at home, but Lens are likely to defend deep after their heavy defeat, which balances out. I found nothing specific on either side's set-piece approach.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.4 cards. Leipzig picked up four yellow cards against City (Christoph Baumgartner, Ridle Baku, Neil El Aynaoui, David Raum), but that was against a stronger side; Lens had two in their 9-1 defeat. I stay with the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.4 shots and I lean a little higher. Lens let Como shoot at will, and Leipzig at home need goals for their goal difference as well as the points. Most of the total should come from the hosts.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.2 shots on target and I lean slightly higher. Como put nine past Lens, so their defence is allowing clear chances, and Leipzig's attack showed against City that it can finish. I expect Leipzig to test the Lens goalkeeper often.
